data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 9.6m (2017: GBP 3.7m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

prior_year_events.event_name: Final settlement of court case relating to the World Trade Center terrorist attack
prior_year_events.impact_description: Final settlement produced releases totalling GBP 4.6m in prior years' reserves (boosting prior years' improvement reported for the 2016 underwriting year).

named_events.loss_description: Occurred towards the end of the year and had a significant impact on the account.
Losses from Hurricane Michael were low for the syndicate.
Syndicate's involvement in the Japanese losses was minimal.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 557 opened 2018 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 36.321m. During 2018 there was favourable prior-year development: a net surplus of GBP 9.6m was recognised relating to the reassessment of claims for previous accident years (a release). No gross prior-year movement was explicitly stated in the notes, so the reported net GBP 9.6m release is used as the quantified prior-year movement. The report notes the 2018 impact from Californian wildfires and other 2018 catastrophe activity (Japan, Hurricane Michael) but indicates minimal exposure to some events; historical releases (e.g. a GBP 4.6m release linked to settlement of a World Trade Center case) are also referenced.
raw_causal_phrases: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 9.6m (2017: GBP 3.7m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.
The vast bulk of these releases were due to the final settlement of a court case relating to the terrorist attack on the World Trade Center in 2001.
It was thus only the fires in California, which occurred towards the end of the year, which had a significant impact on the account.
The catastrophe reinsurance market experienced a number of significant events in 2018, primarily in Japan and the United States.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement (insurance liabilities) figure is provided in the notes. The document explicitly states a NET prior-year surplus of GBP 9.6m; this NET figure has been used as a fallback per instructions and is flagged here. A gross claims development triangle is present but the report does not present an explicit gross 'movement in prior years' line for 2018; therefore the gross PYD could not be directly determined. All monetary amounts are in millions GBP.
